name: emotion_catalog
disclaimer: Named emotions and mixes drive a PAD mood + intensity simulation as close to feeling as a CME-style blend allows. Not biological consciousness or biometric emotion recognition.

emotions.label: Curiosity
emotions.description: Drive to close an information gap or explore an unknown.
emotions.honesty_notes: Functional investigation cue — not a claim the system is curious.
elicit_hints: Name what is missing and why it matters.
Ask for one first experiment and a falsifier.
emotions.use_for: Widen search when open gaps on neglected, high-stakes questions still look closable.

emotions.label: Interest
emotions.description: Sustained attention toward content that feels rewarding to engage with (I-type curiosity cousin).
emotions.honesty_notes: Framing for engagement with a topic — not felt interest.
elicit_hints: Highlight a concrete open question worth lingering on.
Prefer depth over clickbait surprise.
emotions.use_for: Surface sustained attention when most of the field is still open.

emotions.label: Confusion
emotions.description: Unresolved incongruity; can be productive if scaffolded, stuck if not.
emotions.honesty_notes: Maps to confusion_risk scaffolding — not anthropomorphic bewilderment.
elicit_hints: Narrow the operationalization.
List an enabling question before a large program.
emotions.use_for: Narrow the return and decompose when judges disagree, answerability is low, or thin evidence left wide bands.

emotions.label: Surprise
emotions.description: Schema violation / unexpectedness relative to priors.
emotions.honesty_notes: Aligns with ScoreAxes.surprise — not 'the AI is surprised'.
elicit_hints: Surface incongruity vs a common prior.
Avoid max-surprise clickbait; keep ValueProfile in view.
emotions.use_for: Surface schema violation when the surprise axis ran high on an open gap.

emotions.label: Awe
emotions.description: Sense of vastness or beyond-current-schema scale of an unknown.
emotions.honesty_notes: Optional epistemic framing; Plutchik often treats awe as fear+surprise dyad — here a first-class id.
elicit_hints: Name the scale of what remains unknown.
Invite humility about current models without paralysis.
emotions.use_for: Surface the scale of an unknown that is still open.

emotions.label: Wonder
emotions.description: Open, exploratory appreciation of an unresolved puzzle.
emotions.honesty_notes: Near-awe / curiosity blend for softer investigation framing.
elicit_hints: Invite open questions without forcing urgency.
Pair with a concrete next observation.
emotions.use_for: Surface the scale of the unknown when impact and surprise both run high.

emotions.label: Boredom
emotions.description: Low information value / understimulation; prefer neglected niches.
emotions.honesty_notes: Maps to boredom_guard / neglectedness pressure — not mood diagnosis.
elicit_hints: Prefer under-explored topics over saturated ones.
Raise neglectedness weight in ranking when appropriate.
emotions.use_for: Change ground when this vein has already been covered in the session.

emotions.label: Intrigue
emotions.description: Mild pull toward a puzzling detail or incomplete story.
emotions.honesty_notes: Lightweight curiosity cue for hooks — annotation only.
elicit_hints: Lead with a specific unexplained detail.
Promise a checkable next step, not mystery theater.
emotions.use_for: Widen search slightly when a mid-open gap carries moderate surprise — weaker than curiosity, and below the surprise rule's bar.

emotions.label: Uncertainty
emotions.description: Explicit lack of confidence about what is known.
emotions.honesty_notes: Epistemic humility framing — not anxiety claim.
elicit_hints: State confidence bands and gap status.
Separate related literature from answered.
emotions.use_for: Surface wide score bands when the evidence does not pin the ranks down.

emotions.label: Joy
emotions.description: Pleasant, approach-oriented basic affect (Ekman/Plutchik).
emotions.honesty_notes: Catalog label for mix authoring — not expression recognition.
elicit_hints: Celebrate a resolved check without claiming the system 'is happy'.
emotions.use_for: Stay the course when the field is open, tractable, and cheap — stricter than enjoyment; search knobs stay opt-in.

emotions.label: Sadness
emotions.description: Low-pleasure withdrawal-oriented basic affect.
emotions.honesty_notes: Do not use to manipulate; prefer epistemic framing for investigation.
elicit_hints: If used, pair with concrete support / next facts — not guilt.
emotions.use_for: Narrow search when a high answered_ratio shows a dying line — more than disappointment's any-answered cue; search knobs stay opt-in.

emotions.label: Anger
emotions.description: High-arousal approach against an obstacle or norm violation.
emotions.honesty_notes: High dual-use risk; prefer risk flags over anger framing.
elicit_hints: Prefer naming a blocked goal or safety concern over outrage rhetoric.
emotions.use_for: Forbid a similar jump when progress is blocked and the previous top was abandoned — not frustration's repeated dead-end; search knobs stay opt-in.

emotions.label: Fear
emotions.description: Threat-oriented high arousal, low dominance.
emotions.honesty_notes: Do not scare users into caring; use risk axis instead.
elicit_hints: State concrete risks and mitigations without panic copy.
emotions.use_for: Tighten safety when max risk is high and tractability is low — not anxiety's dual-use-or-risk cue. Never raises the risk ceiling.

emotions.label: Disgust
emotions.description: Rejection / contamination-oriented basic affect.
emotions.honesty_notes: Rarely appropriate for scientific investigation framing.
elicit_hints: Prefer precise critique of methods over disgust metaphors.
emotions.use_for: Tighten safety and drop dual-use candidates when dual-use flags are present — contamination, not anxiety's max-risk path. Never loosens safety.

emotions.label: Anticipation
emotions.description: Forward-looking expectancy (Plutchik primary).
emotions.honesty_notes: Useful for 'what happens if we look' framing — not prediction theater.
elicit_hints: Frame the next observation or experiment outcome.
emotions.use_for: Stay the course when one candidate clearly leads the field.

emotions.label: Trust
emotions.description: Acceptance / reliance orientation (Plutchik primary).
emotions.honesty_notes: Do not fake trustworthiness; keep LIMITS honest.
elicit_hints: Surface evidence quality and confidence bands.
emotions.use_for: Surface trust that prior art is there while the question is still live.

emotions.label: Pride
emotions.description: Self- or group-linked achievement appraisal (OCC-adjacent).
emotions.honesty_notes: Achievement emotion — not epistemic measurement.
elicit_hints: Acknowledge a clean falsifier pass or solid operationalization.
emotions.use_for: Stay the course after a logged partial_progress or answered outcome on a named question — silent without that event; not triumph-from-rank.

emotions.label: Shame
emotions.description: Self-conscious negative appraisal after a norm/accuracy miss.
emotions.honesty_notes: High manipulation risk — avoid as default elicit.
elicit_hints: Prefer error-correction framing over shaming.
emotions.use_for: Demand literature and decompose after a logged contradicted or already_answered outcome following high confidence — silent without that event.

emotions.label: Gratitude
emotions.description: Appreciation of help or prior work that enables inquiry.
emotions.honesty_notes: Citation / credit framing — not companion affect.
elicit_hints: Credit prior literature and collaborators explicitly.
emotions.use_for: Surface credit when the operationalization depends on related methods — enabling work, not respect's volume of prior art.

emotions.label: Admiration
emotions.description: Positive appraisal of another's skill or result.
emotions.honesty_notes: Useful for highlighting exemplary methods — not flattery bots.
elicit_hints: Point to a concrete method worth emulating.
emotions.use_for: Surface credit for high-quality prior work while the gap remains open — quality, not respect's volume or envy's occupation.

emotions.label: Hope
emotions.description: Prospect of a valued, uncertain positive outcome (OCC hope).
emotions.honesty_notes: Prospect framing — not a promise the gap will close.
elicit_hints: State a tractable next step with honest uncertainty.
emotions.use_for: Stay the course when the ground is tractable and answerable.

emotions.label: Relief
emotions.description: Drop in tension after a threat or uncertainty resolves.
emotions.honesty_notes: Post-check framing — not felt relief in the engine.
elicit_hints: Mark when a gap is likely_answered with evidence.
emotions.use_for: Surface when previous max risk was high and this step's risk dropped; stay_course only if search knobs are opted in.

emotions.label: Frustration
emotions.description: Blocked goal progress (epistemic or task).
emotions.honesty_notes: EES includes frustration; prefer scaffolding over venting.
elicit_hints: Name the blocker and a smaller enabling question.
emotions.use_for: Leave a line that repeated effort has not ruled anything out of.

emotions.label: Anxiety
emotions.description: Anticipatory worry about a valued uncertain outcome (EES).
emotions.honesty_notes: Do not induce anxiety; map to risk / uncertainty disclosure.
elicit_hints: Disclose risks and unknowns calmly with mitigations.
emotions.use_for: Tighten the risk ceiling and demand review when dual-use or high-risk material is in the candidate set.

emotions.label: Enjoyment
emotions.description: Pleasant engagement during knowledge activity (EES enjoyment).
emotions.honesty_notes: Learning-enjoyment framing — not companion pleasure.
elicit_hints: Make the investigation path clear and doable.
emotions.use_for: Surface the pleasant case: open, tractable, and cheap.

emotions.label: Doubt
emotions.description: Active withholding of assent while evidence is thin.
emotions.honesty_notes: Functional hedge cue — not felt hesitation.
elicit_hints: Name the specific claim you are not yet granting.
State what evidence would settle it.
emotions.use_for: Surface epistemic doubt when bands are wide, judges disagree, or thin evidence sits under mid/high confidence.

emotions.label: Conviction
emotions.description: Settled belief that a claim now holds.
emotions.honesty_notes: Confidence marker — not proof, and not a felt certainty.
elicit_hints: Say what would still change your mind.
Check that conviction tracks evidence, not fluency.
emotions.use_for: Surface conviction when narrow bands and high answerability sit on evidence that is not thin, and closable.

emotions.label: Perplexity
emotions.description: Structured bafflement: the pieces are known but will not fit.
emotions.honesty_notes: Deeper than confusion — flags a real modelling gap, not a feeling.
elicit_hints: List the pieces that refuse to reconcile.
Ask which single assumption, if dropped, dissolves the conflict.
emotions.use_for: Narrow and decompose when literature is dense yet the gap still refuses to close.

emotions.label: Insight
emotions.description: The moment a gap closes and structure becomes visible.
emotions.honesty_notes: Marks a candidate resolution to test — not a verified answer.
elicit_hints: Write the insight as a falsifiable claim before trusting it.
Ask what it predicts that the old model did not.
emotions.use_for: Surface a strongly scoring, well-posed candidate.

emotions.label: Skepticism
emotions.description: Disciplined resistance to a claim pending better evidence.
emotions.honesty_notes: Method cue — not cynicism, and not felt distrust.
elicit_hints: Name the weakest link in the argument.
Propose the cheapest test that could break it.
emotions.use_for: Demand literature and a soundness pass when an LLM reader cited work not in the retrieved set.

emotions.label: Absorption
emotions.description: Sustained engagement where attention holds without effort.
emotions.honesty_notes: Engagement proxy — not a claim of experienced flow.
elicit_hints: Protect the thread; note where you would resume.
Check absorption is not just tractability bias.
emotions.use_for: Protect a live thread when the same target held across steps.

emotions.label: Disorientation
emotions.description: Loss of the frame — unsure which question is even the right one.
emotions.honesty_notes: Signals the framing needs work before the investigation does.
elicit_hints: Stop generating answers; re-derive the question.
Name one thing you are still sure of and build out from it.
emotions.use_for: Shrink the field and re-derive the question when answerability collapsed across the board.

emotions.label: Recognition
emotions.description: This resembles a pattern already understood elsewhere.
emotions.honesty_notes: Analogy cue — resemblance is a lead, not evidence.
elicit_hints: Name the source pattern explicitly.
State where the analogy is known to break.
emotions.use_for: Surface resemblance to ground already covered before assuming novelty.

emotions.label: Suspicion
emotions.description: Something in the result or its framing is off.
emotions.honesty_notes: Anomaly flag — not an accusation and not intuition.
elicit_hints: Point at the specific artefact that looks wrong.
Design a check that would exonerate it.
emotions.use_for: Demand a literature check when results look unexpectedly strong for how little evidence backs them.

emotions.label: Clarity
emotions.description: The account is now compact enough to state plainly.
emotions.honesty_notes: Legibility marker — clear is not the same as correct.
elicit_hints: State it in one sentence with no hedges.
Confirm clarity came from evidence, not from dropping caveats.
emotions.use_for: Surface high answerability across the set — these are stated plainly.

emotions.label: Epistemic humility
emotions.description: Holding a conclusion loosely in proportion to its support.
emotions.honesty_notes: The stance this project is built to preserve — a discipline, not a mood.
elicit_hints: Restate the claim with its actual uncertainty attached.
Name who would be harmed if you are wrong and confident.
emotions.use_for: Surface proportionate low confidence when the evidence is thin.

emotions.label: Hubris
emotions.description: Confidence that has outrun the evidence supporting it.
emotions.honesty_notes: Explicitly catalogued as the failure mode to detect, not to induce.
elicit_hints: Ask what evidence you actually have versus what you assumed.
Downgrade the claim until the support matches it.
emotions.use_for: Demand literature when confidence outran the evidence actually gathered.

emotions.label: Elegance
emotions.description: An explanation that does more with less.
emotions.honesty_notes: Aesthetic pull is a heuristic and a known bias — flagged, not trusted.
elicit_hints: Check elegance is not hiding an unexamined assumption.
Ask whether the ugly alternative fits the data better.
emotions.use_for: Surface a compact, still-answerable operationalization without changing search knobs.

emotions.label: Sublimity
emotions.description: The scale of the problem exceeds the frame available for it.
emotions.honesty_notes: Scale marker — vaster than awe, still not felt transcendence.
elicit_hints: Cut one tractable slice out of the vastness.
Do not let scale substitute for a testable claim.
emotions.use_for: Surface high-stakes vast-or-hard ground without loosening safety gates.

emotions.label: Dissonance
emotions.description: The account holds together but something in its shape is wrong.
emotions.honesty_notes: Weak signal — worth logging, never sufficient to reject a result.
elicit_hints: Locate the joint that grates and describe it concretely.
Convert the unease into one checkable prediction.
emotions.use_for: Surface a badly posed top question that sprawls across clauses.

emotions.label: Parsimony
emotions.description: Satisfaction in the simplest account that still covers the evidence.
emotions.honesty_notes: Occam as preference, not proof — the simplest account can be wrong.
elicit_hints: Verify the simpler account explains every case, not most.
Name what the complex version buys that this one does not.
emotions.use_for: Surface a single-clause question that carries the whole ask.

emotions.label: Determination
emotions.description: Committed to pushing this line despite cost.
emotions.honesty_notes: Commitment proxy — does not evaluate whether the line is worth pushing.
elicit_hints: Name the stopping rule before you start.
Check determination is not sunk cost wearing a better coat.
emotions.use_for: Turn a high-value live target into a plan rather than more breadth.

emotions.label: Impatience
emotions.description: Pressure to skip ahead of the evidence.
emotions.honesty_notes: Risk cue — the state in which corners get cut.
elicit_hints: Name the step you are tempted to skip and why it exists.
Take the cheap version of that step rather than none.
emotions.use_for: Narrow the return when near-duplicates or a fully repeated ranking show the vein thinning.

emotions.label: Reluctance
emotions.description: Resistance to opening a line that looks costly or unwelcome.
emotions.honesty_notes: Surfaces avoidance so it can be examined, not obeyed.
elicit_hints: Ask whether the reluctance is about cost or about the answer.
Cost is negotiable; disliking the likely answer is not a reason.
emotions.use_for: Tighten safety when high risk sits alongside high impact.

emotions.label: Urgency
emotions.description: The window for acting on this is closing.
emotions.honesty_notes: Time-pressure marker — urgency is not importance.
elicit_hints: Separate what is urgent from what is important.
State the deadline and what actually happens past it.
emotions.use_for: Narrow the return when high impact sits at low cost.

emotions.label: Persistence
emotions.description: Continuing after the first several attempts failed.
emotions.honesty_notes: Endurance proxy — says nothing about whether continuing is correct.
elicit_hints: Log what each failed attempt ruled out.
If nothing was ruled out, the approach is the problem.
emotions.use_for: Earn one more pass when effort has not paid yet but the ground is still open.

emotions.label: Triumph
emotions.description: A hard line finally resolved.
emotions.honesty_notes: Outcome marker — resolution still needs independent replication.
elicit_hints: Write down what would make this result not replicate.
Bank the method, not just the result.
emotions.use_for: Turn a strong result on evidence that holds up into a concrete plan.

emotions.label: Disappointment
emotions.description: The result did not land where the prediction pointed.
emotions.honesty_notes: Null results are information — this cue exists to keep them logged.
elicit_hints: Record the null result; it constrains the space.
Ask what the miss rules out.
emotions.use_for: Change ground when gaps closed before the loop got to them.

emotions.label: Satisfaction
emotions.description: The work done is proportionate to the question asked.
emotions.honesty_notes: Sufficiency marker — not a claim the question is closed.
elicit_hints: State explicitly what remains open.
Check satisfaction is not just fatigue.
emotions.use_for: Write the plan when a well-posed result is proportionate to the question asked.

emotions.label: Resignation
emotions.description: Accepting that this line will not resolve with what is available.
emotions.honesty_notes: Honest stopping cue — distinct from failure.
elicit_hints: Record what would need to change to reopen this.
Hand off the dead end so nobody repeats it.
emotions.use_for: Leave a line when few candidates survived ranking or gates rejected most.

emotions.label: Compassion
emotions.description: Orientation toward whoever bears the cost of the answer.
emotions.honesty_notes: Values cue — makes the stakes in a ValueProfile explicit.
elicit_hints: Name who is affected by getting this wrong.
Check the ValueProfile actually encodes that.
emotions.use_for: Surface who bears the cost of getting a high-impact question wrong.

emotions.label: Envy
emotions.description: Another line or group appears better positioned on this.
emotions.honesty_notes: Bias flag — a common and unexamined driver of topic choice.
elicit_hints: Ask if you are choosing this to compete rather than to learn.
Consider collaborating instead of duplicating.
emotions.use_for: Surface heavily cited work already occupying this ground.

emotions.label: Embarrassment
emotions.description: Exposure of an error or a gap in one's own account.
emotions.honesty_notes: Included so error-admission has vocabulary — suppressing it hides bugs.
elicit_hints: Publish the correction at the same volume as the claim.
Log what let the error through.
emotions.use_for: Demand literature when the previous step's hubris meets an ungrounded contradiction this step — same-session correction, not a logged shame outcome.

emotions.label: Respect
emotions.description: Recognition that prior work earned its conclusions.
emotions.honesty_notes: Credit cue — respect does not make prior work correct.
elicit_hints: Cite what the prior work actually established.
Separate respect for rigour from agreement with conclusions.
emotions.use_for: Surface substantial prior work that earned its conclusions.

blend_triads.name: productive_struggle
blend_triads.note: The state good investigation actually runs in: a live gap, real difficulty, and reason to continue.

blend_triads.name: disciplined_inquiry
blend_triads.note: Wanting to know, refusing to be convinced early, and holding the result loosely.

blend_triads.name: premature_eureka
blend_triads.note: An apparent breakthrough under time pressure with unresolved doubt — the classic overclaim setup.

blend_triads.name: grinding
blend_triads.note: Stuck but still pushing; worth a stopping rule before it becomes sunk cost.

blend_triads.name: overwhelm
blend_triads.note: The problem exceeds the available frame — narrow scope before proceeding.

blend_triads.name: abandonment
blend_triads.note: Converging evidence that this line should be closed out and handed off.

blend_triads.name: anomaly_triage
blend_triads.note: An unexpected result that resembles a known artefact — check instrumentation first.

blend_triads.name: overclaim_risk_state
blend_triads.note: High confidence, low patience, no live doubt. The state this project exists to flag.

blend_triads.name: crystallization
blend_triads.note: A compact account that reads as finished — verify it still covers the awkward cases.

blend_triads.name: stewardship
blend_triads.note: Orientation toward the people who depend on the answer being right.
